_comment: Curated card links: references the automatic resolver cannot settle, answered by hand. Each entry says "this printed phrase, carrying this collection number, in this language, is THIS ArkhamDB card". Applied by tools/adb_names.py after every automatic attempt has failed, so an entry here never overrides something the data already proves. Every entry must match at least once or the build says so, the same guard tools/text_fixes.json uses. Set "code" to "" to say "there is no card for this" and silence it deliberately.
